# Version 4.148.0
> **First stable v4 release** · Released June 22, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.148.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.148.0)

> **Supersedes [4.147.0](4.147.0.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.148.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148. This release rolls up all v4 work from the 4.147.x previews: variable fonts, animated WebP, SKStream.GetData, color font palettes, and a singleton lifecycle rework. It is a breaking release — check the changes section before upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

- **new SKFont() now has an empty typeface — text may measure as zero width** — Upstream m132 removed lazy typeface resolution; new SKFont() now stores SKTypeface.Empty rather than resolving the platform default at draw time. MeasureText and drawing silently return 0 / draw nothing. Migration: pass an explicit typeface — new SKFont(SKTypeface.Default) — and detect 'no typeface set' with font.Typeface.IsEmpty instead of null checks.
- **new SKPaint().Typeface is now SKTypeface.Default, not null** — The underlying font was seeded from SKFont() (null → lazy) to SKFont(MakeEmpty()). SkiaSharp mitigates this so text still draws, but paint.Typeface == null no longer fires. Use paint.Typeface.IsEmpty or drop the null check — a usable default is always present and SKPaint.Reset() restores it.
- **SKTypeface.FromFamilyName for a missing family now returns Default on all platforms** — Android previously returned null for an unknown family; all platforms now return SKTypeface.Default. For strict null semantics use SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily(name) instead, which still returns null on no match.
- **SKStream.Move(long) is now obsolete and throws OverflowException for out-of-range offsets** — The native offset is 32-bit; the long overload previously silently truncated large values. It is now checked and marked [Obsolete]. Migration: call Move(int) with a validated in-range offset.
- **GRContext.CreateVulkan aborts the process (not null) if Vulkan 1.0 is used** — Skia m139/m140 made Vulkan 1.1 mandatory. A Vulkan 1.0 instance or a GRVkBackendContext with MaxAPIVersion left at 0 now calls SK_ABORT — the process terminates, not a catchable exception. Fix: set VkApplicationInfo.apiVersion = VK_API_VERSION_1_1 and set GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion to the same value.
- **GRVkBackendContextNative: five fields removed** — fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures, and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice are gone. Replace fExtensions with fVkExtensions and fFeatures with fDeviceFeatures / fDeviceFeatures2. fOwnsInstanceAndDevice has no replacement.
- **GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo type changed; GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo lost value-equality** — The property type changed from GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo to GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo (renamed struct). The old struct also lost IEquatable<T> and the == / != operators. A new Components field was added to GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo.
- **Pre-v4 obsolete text/font members on SKPaint are now compile errors** — SKPaint members deprecated in v3 (TextSize, Typeface, etc. accessed as font state on the paint) were promoted from warnings to errors. Move typeface and text size onto SKFont. ([#4068](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4068), [#4114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4114), [#4205](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4205))
- **SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose setter removed** — The protected setter on IgnorePublicDispose has been removed from the public surface. Subclasses that assigned it must use the existing constructor parameter or constructor chaining instead.

## Engine

- **Skia engine updated from m132 to m148** — The underlying Skia engine jumped four milestones (m132 → m133 → m147 → m148), bringing all upstream rendering, text, and GPU improvements from those releases. Multiple upstream cherry-pick syncs from the m147 branch were also applied. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125), [#4081](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4081), [#4044](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4044))

## API Surface

- **Variable font support in SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp** — SKTypeface and SKFont expose variable font axis enumeration and value control. HarfBuzzSharp gains matching variable-font APIs, enabling per-glyph axis adjustments for weight, width, slant, and custom axes. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3703](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3703))
- **Animated WebP encoding added to SKWebpEncoder** — SKWebpEncoder can now produce animated WebP files from a sequence of frames, completing the WebP encode/decode feature set. ([#3771](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3771))
- **Zero-copy SKStream.GetData() conversion** — A new SKStream.GetData() method converts a stream to an SKData without an extra copy, useful for passing in-memory streams directly to APIs that require SKData. ([#3772](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3772))
- **Color font palette support and improved variable font robustness** — New APIs expose color font palette enumeration and selection, allowing consumers to choose a palette for emoji and icon fonts. Variable font support is made more robust across edge cases. ([#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742))
- **SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface now accept SKSamplingOptions** — DrawSurface and the related surface Draw overload now accept an SKSamplingOptions parameter, giving callers control over the sampling filter used when compositing a surface. ([#3491](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3491))
- **HBColor struct for correct hb_color_t representation** — A new HBColor struct correctly maps to the HarfBuzz hb_color_t type, enabling accurate color retrieval from color font APIs. ([#4000](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4000))
- **Missing API wrappers added and naming violations fixed** — Several HarfBuzz APIs that were exposed in native headers but missing from the managed layer are now wrapped, and a number of naming convention violations are corrected. ([#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))

## Bug Fixes

- **SKPixmap/SKBitmap GetPixelSpan stride and axis offset corrected** — GetPixelSpan was using the wrong value for row stride (width instead of RowBytes) and the wrong axis for the per-pixel offset, producing incorrect pixel pointers on non-packed bitmaps. ([#4148](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4148), [#4128](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4128))
- **SKPath finalizer crash when SKPathBuilder is GC-collected first** — If an SKPath was built from an SKPathBuilder and the builder was collected before the path, the path's finalizer could crash accessing freed memory. The lifetime dependency is now handled correctly. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3796](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3796))
- **Default typeface resolution moved to the managed layer on Android** — Android API 36+ could return null from the native font manager when resolving the default typeface, causing crashes. Default resolution now goes through the managed layer and falls back to SKTypeface.Empty instead of failing. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730))
- **WinUI Projection DLL not found on .NET 9 fixed** — Consumers using the WinUI projection on .NET 9 no longer encounter a DllNotFoundException when loading the projection assembly. ([#4084](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4084))
- **Native compat gate moved to SkiaApi static constructor** — The platform compatibility check was previously in a [ModuleInitializer], which could run too early or too late on some runtimes. It is now in the SkiaApi static constructor, ensuring it runs exactly when the binding is first used. ([#4133](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4133))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Singleton instance lifecycle reworked** — The lifetime of shared singleton instances (like default typefaces and font managers) is now managed with explicit reference counting rather than relying on GC ordering, eliminating a class of crashes where a singleton could be finalized while still in use. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4080))

## Platform

- **Linux Bionic native assets added** — Native binaries for Linux Bionic (Android's Linux userspace) are now included, enabling SkiaSharp use in Bionic-based Linux environments. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217))
- **Tizen x64 and arm64 native build support** — Native Tizen builds are extended to x64 and arm64 architectures, expanding device coverage for Tizen targets. ([#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620))
- **Apple platform TFMs corrected for libraries and apps** — Library TFMs now use the versioned 26.0 form while app TFMs use the unversioned form, aligning with Apple SDK requirements and fixing deployment issues on newer Apple OS versions. ([#3798](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3798))
- **SKGLView rendering after tab switch in MAUI TabBar fixed** — On MAUI Android, SKGLView stopped rendering after switching away from and back to a tab containing it. The surface is now correctly reinitialized on tab re-entry. — ❤️ [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez) ([#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076))
- **WASM pre-.NET 8 Emscripten builds dropped** — Native WASM builds for Emscripten versions earlier than the .NET 8 baseline are no longer produced, reducing build matrix size and focusing support on current .NET WASM targets. ([#4022](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4022))

## Security

- **Native dependency refreshes: expat, libjpeg-turbo, freetype, libpng, libexpat, harfbuzz, zlib** — expat updated to 2.8.1, libjpeg-turbo to 3.1.4.1, freetype to 2.14.3, libpng to 1.6.58, libexpat to 2.7.5, HarfBuzz to 14.2.0, and zlib to 1.3.2.1-motley, picking up upstream security and bug fixes. ([#4079](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4079), [#4012](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4012), [#3726](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3726), [#3718](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3718), [#3717](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3717), [#4035](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4035), [#3720](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3720))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0

HarfBuzz 14.2.0 ships with variable font axis support, proper hb_color_t representation via the new HBColor struct, and several missing API wrappers that align the managed surface with the native HarfBuzz header.

## Release Candidate 1 (June 12, 2026)

Release Candidate 1 delivered the final Skia m148 update, the SKPixmap pixel-span fixes, the last round of pre-v4 obsolete-to-error promotions, the singleton lifecycle rework, the SKPaint text/font member errors, expat 2.8.1 and libjpeg-turbo 3.1.4.1 security updates, and the WinUI .NET 9 projection fix.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.147.0-preview.3.1...v4.148.0-rc.1.2)

## Preview 3 (May 24, 2026)

Preview 3 integrated the libjpeg-turbo, freetype, libpng, and libexpat security refreshes, HBColor, the missing API wrappers, warnings-as-errors cleanup, CI fixes, the Uno gallery Skottie fix, and the initial Skia m148 preview sync.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.147.0-preview.2.1...v4.147.0-preview.3.1)

## Preview 2 (May 6, 2026)

Preview 2 added animated WebP encoding, SKStream.GetData, the SKPath finalizer fix, the Apple TFM correction, Emscripten WASM drops for pre-.NET 8, and HarfBuzz 14.2.0.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.147.0-preview.1.1...v4.147.0-preview.2.1)

## Preview 1 (April 28, 2026)

Preview 1 established the v4 baseline: the Skia m147 engine bump, variable font support, color font palette APIs, SKSamplingOptions for DrawSurface, Linux Bionic assets, Tizen x64/arm64, SKGLView tab-switch fix, PolySharp for legacy TFMs, and the initial contributor infrastructure for the new v4 branch.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v3.119.4...v4.147.0-preview.1.1)
